leads.posting: Edoofa are looking to hire - Junior Software Engineers. Work Mode - Remote Experience - 0 to 1 year We are seeking an enthusiastic, self-motivated Junior Software Engineer (Java) to join our fully remote engineering team. This is a fresher-friendly role designed for recent graduates or early-career developers who are eager to kickstart their professional journey from the comfort of their homes. You will receive structured remote mentorship from senior engineers, collaborate via modern digital workspaces, and write code that powers our core backend applications. Responsibilities: Feature Development: Write clean, maintainable, and efficient Java code to implement new features and enhance existing modules. Remote Collaboration: Participate actively in virtual agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups via Zoom/Teams, Slack updates, and digital sprint planning). Testing & Quality: Write unit tests using frameworks like JUnit to ensure code reliability. Bug Fixing: Troubleshoot and resolve software defects identified in development or staging environments. Documentation: Maintain clear documentation for application design and APIs to ensure seamless team collaboration in an asynchronous environment. Required Skills: Core Java: Solid understanding of Java fundamentals, including Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles, Collections, and Exception Handling. Frameworks: Academic or internship exposure to Spring Boot or Spring MVC. Databases: Basic knowledge of writing standard SQL queries (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL). Version Control: Foundational proficiency with Git and GitHub/GitLab. Competencies: Experience: 0 to 1 year (Freshers with strong personal projects or internship experience are highly encouraged to apply). Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, as this is vital for a remote setup. Kindly apply on Linkedin only. Do not share profile on email, to avoid duplication. leads.title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
leads.posting: Wipro is hiring for the role of Graduate Engineer Trainee! Responsibilities of the Candidate: Configure and test Wipro's proprietary Total Benefit Administration™ (TBA) System by setting up tables/parameters, preparing test cases/test data, and executing test activities based on analysis and direction from the Systems Analyst (SA). Review client requirements documents and preliminary test plans, adhere to deadlines, ask clarifying questions, use handoff times effectively, utilize problem-solving resources, and escalate issues appropriately. Identify needed test cases, complete test plans, document relevant configurations in analysis specs, fix issues found during test execution, and perform stress testing. Effectively manage tasks, prioritize work, proactively provide status updates to managers, tie test plans to real-time customer impact, think of test cases beyond the provided plan, and aggressively test the system. Requirements: Education: B.Tech / BE (Computer Science, Information Technology, and Electronics & Communication Engineering) or MCA pass outs only. Role & Logistics: Manual Tester / Graduate Trainee Engineer (Backend) role located in Gurugram, Haryana (Day shift, 5 days work from office, with both-side cabs depending on the address falling within the hiring zone). Core Technical & Quality Skills: Knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) principles/concepts. Knowledge of system testing, software quality assurance best practices, and automation testing principles/exposure. Strong analytical skills to break down complex problems and understand relationships between pieces. Knowledge of basic relational database concepts (table relationships, keys, SQL, and DB2 queries) and ability to write intermediate SQL queries. Experience with system implementations and troubleshooting intermediate system defects/errors. Good understanding of data analysis and debugging skills. Mandatory Skills: Health and Welfare (HW) Tech. Behavioral & Communication Skill

Responsibilities of the Intern: Support the development of data-driven solutions and analytics models for forecasting, inventory monitoring, capacity planning, and supply chain optimization. Build and maintain data pipelines, datasets, and analytical solutions using tools such as SQL, Databricks, PySpark, and related technologies. Create Power BI dashboards and reports that help business users monitor trends, performance metrics, variances, and operational insights. Validate analytical outputs against business requirements, approved calculations, and historical data to ensure accuracy and reliability. Collaborate with supply chain, operations, and digital teams to identify opportunities where data and analytics can improve decision-making and business outcomes. Requirements: Currently pursuing or recently completed a B.E., B.Tech., M.Tech., or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. Foundational knowledge of Python, SQL, and Microsoft Excel with an interest in data analytics and business intelligence. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail. Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Eagerness to learn new technologies and apply data-driven approaches to solve business challenges.
